name: Anders Behring Breivik
role: Norwegian far-right terrorist behind the 2011 Oslo and Utøya attacks (born 1979)
summary: Breivik is a Norwegian ultranationalist convicted of the 22 July 2011 bombing and mass shooting that killed 77 people. His 2011 manifesto calls for a monocultural, patriarchal, Christian-cultural Europe, the deportation or forced assimilation of Muslims, protectionist trade and armed resistance against what he calls cultural Marxism.

abolish-ip.rationale: Section 3.94 complains that Asian countries do not respect intellectual property ownership and that their products are stolen or misused.

abortion-legal.rationale: The social-structure sections allow abortion only after rape, to save the mother, or for disability, and list making it illegal as a way to raise fertility (3.90).

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Book 3 (3.18-3.23) holds that small clandestine cells of one or two people using "shock attacks" will break the system and start the wider conservative revolution.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Section 3.10 requires Muslims to convert, take European names, drop their language and customs, over at least 50 years.

central-planning.rationale: Section 3.94 says a socialist or even a planned economy must be avoided at all costs.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: His 2011 attacks killed 77 people, most of them young civilians at a summer camp, which he framed as war against the "multiculturalist" system.

civilizational-union.rationale: Sections 3.94 and 3.98 propose a European Federation of Europe, Russia, the US and allied countries with a shared anthem, independence day and economic zone.

death-penalty.rationale: Section 3.98 makes execution or banishment the third-strike penalty and 3.80 backs extended use of the death penalty.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Section 3.85 says opposing race-mixing is persecuted and that most people want partners from their own group; he sides with preserving the "tribe".

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Sections 3.82 and 3.90 call for re-implementing patriarchy and steering women toward family and part-time work rather than careers.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Sections 3.91 and 3.94 base monoculturalism on social cohesion and say a solid welfare system depends on a monocultural society.

elite-replacement.rationale: Sections 3.23 and 3.85 say the multiculturalist elites are deliberately committing genocide on Europeans through mass Muslim immigration and reproductive policy.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Sections 3.84 and 3.91 call for monoculturalism and ethnocentric defence of the indigenous European peoples.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Section 3.96 calls for building a vast network of nuclear power plants as the cleanest available energy.

free-trade.rationale: Sections 3.94 and 3.96 reject globalist trade and call for protectionist barriers and an end to outsourcing outside the economic zone.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Section 3.89 says gender-based affirmative action must stop and criticises Norway's 40% female board quota.

human-enhancement.rationale: Section 3.96 wants voluntary reprogenetics legalised so parents can improve offspring, and a brain-computer interface; it is about offspring and not stated for adults themselves.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Sections 3.9-3.10 treat even secular Muslims as fully Muslim and require converting to Christianity to stay in Europe.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Sections 3.91, 3.98 and 3.100 say a future Europe protects Israel and back its security fence and the defence of Israelis.

limit-population.rationale: Section 3.96 wants one-child policies in poorer high-birth-rate countries to curb overpopulation, while section 3.90 wants higher birth rates in Europe.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Section 3.98 proposes a three-strike rule against any and all criminals.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Section 3.94 wants a sustainable economy based on many free-market mechanisms with strong incentives, while rejecting pure laissez-faire.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Book 3 (3.63, 3.64) argues for honouring fallen "martyrs" of the resistance with orders, commendations and tombstones.

nation-first.rationale: Section 3.98 says the future European Federation should be inward looking, with isolationist and protectionist principles.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Section 3.83 calls no-fault divorce one of the most dangerous social experiments and wants divorce law reversed.

one-party-rule.rationale: Section 3.91 says a one-party-state system must be avoided as undesirable in the long run.

open-borders.rationale: Sections 3.9 and 3.91 call for deporting Muslims and re-establishing a European monoculture.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Section 3.89 describes Western European society as a matriarchal system to be dismantled, not one that favours men.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: He bombed the Oslo government quarter and shot dozens of youths at Utøya in 2011 to advance his political aims; the court convicted him of terror and killing 77 people.

population-transfer.rationale: Sections 3.9 and 3.10 demand that all Muslims who do not convert and assimilate be deported from Europe.

premarital-sex.rationale: Sections 3.86 and 3.90 say sex should only be encouraged within marriage and call for discouraging casual sex among women.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Section 3.91 makes the monoculture and Christendom's position permanent, on the model of Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Section 3.90 proposes welfare incentives, tax deductions and family benefits for larger families, on the Australian and Japanese models.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: Book 3 chapter 3.54 sets out sabotage operations as the most efficient way to cripple the multiculturalist regimes.

public-ownership.rationale: Section 3.94 cuts the public sector from about 50-60% to 25% and rejects socialism, yet the energy chapter (3.96) would put at least 50.1% of every globalist company in state hands.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Section 3.80 backs new and enforced restrictions on immigration and asylum, and section 3.9 demands deporting Muslims or forcing assimilation.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: His 2011 bombing aimed at the central government administration and democratic institutions, intended to topple the existing order by force, as found by the court.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Section 3.97 argues that foreign aid to Africa causes corruption and poverty and should end.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Section 3.83 says homosexuals claim marriage only because traditional marriage was undermined, and he lists gay marriage among the Church's failings (3.80).

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Section 3.97 argues aid harms Africa and that poor countries should rely on trade and their own governance.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Section 3.83 says the father or patriarch must gain more influence and that matriarchal supremacy in households must end.

social-market-economy.rationale: Section 3.94 keeps a free-market economy with a solid welfare system on the Scandinavian model, to a degree, for citizens.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Section 3.80 says the Church will be reformed and not be allowed to steer domestic policy such as immigration and the death penalty.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Sections 3.94 and 3.96 call for significantly higher import taxes and toll barriers around a European economic zone, and for expelling China from the WTO.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Section 3.98 says Europe must never attack another sovereign country, yet claims land in Anatolia and north and south of Israel to hand to others.

traditional-family.rationale: Sections 3.82-3.90 call for restoring the patriarchal nuclear family and a "back to the 50s" model as the basis of society.

notes: Only the manifesto's own Book 3 programme and the court record are used; Books 1 and 2 mostly copy other authors' essays and are skipped. Themes searched: economy, society and gender, immigration, religion, democracy, crime, ecology, technology and world. The statement list is far longer than what his texts address, so most answers are null.
